name: Melor Sends Word
summary: Jorn Skyseer brings word from Melor Stonehoof to promising hunters in the Barrens. Those who have proved their grit across Kalimdor are called to Hunter's Rise in Thunder Bluff for a harder trial.

sections.title: A Summons to Thunder Bluff
sections.body: Across the Barrens, Jorn Skyseer watches the crossings and encampments. He carries word from the elders of Hunter's Rise to hunters and warriors who have shown promise in the surrounding lands. Melor Stonehoof, a revered tauren mentor, has marked out a path for them.

sections.title: The Road to the Hunt
sections.body: At Hunter's Rise in Thunder Bluff, you meet Melor Stonehoof. The elder hunter asks if you have the resolve to venture into distant, perilous wilderness. His summons opens trials far beyond the safety of Mulgore, where hunters face the continent's fiercest predators.

faq.answer: Melor Stonehoof is a veteran tauren hunter on Hunter's Rise in Thunder Bluff. He judges rising trackers and warriors of the Horde, then sends worthy candidates across Kalimdor to track and hunt notorious beasts.
Jorn Skyseer, a tauren beastmaster at Camp Taurajo in the Barrens, carries the message. He watches over travelers and sends those who have shown courage to Thunder Bluff to speak with Melor.

faq.q: Where can I find Melor Stonehoof?
faq.answer: Melor is on Hunter's Rise, the southern mesa of Thunder Bluff devoted to tauren hunters, trackers, and beastmasters.

faq.q: What path is Melor planning for me?
aliases: next quest after melor sends word
faq.answer: Melor tests your endurance and hunting instincts with difficult tracking expeditions. The first sends you across Thousand Needles to hunt Steelsnap, a vicious hyena tyrant.

faq.q: Why does Melor recruit adventurers from the Barrens?
faq.answer: Surviving the Barrens' harsh predators, quilboar, and centaur shows that you have the instincts for elite hunts. Melor seeks those who can track elusive, deadly prey in unfamiliar lands.

faq.q: Is this trial restricted to hunters?
faq.answer: Melor's trial is open to any Horde adventurer who has proved strength and resourcefulness in the wild. It begins on Hunter's Rise and tests the virtues of a tracker.

angles.text: As a tauren, answering Melor's call is a traditional rite of adulthood and standing. You prove your mastery of the Hunt and bring honor to Hunter's Rise.
As a hunter, you see tauren beastcraft in Melor Stonehoof. He demands precision, patience, and respect for dangerous quarry.
As a member of the Horde, you know Camp Taurajo and Thunder Bluff rely on skilled field operatives to manage dangerous predators near supply routes and outposts.
